Hi team,

Congrats — Valence signed yesterday afternoon. Attaching the high-level commercial summary and the HubSpot link below. Key points for CS/implementation: 
- Target go-live: 2027-07-01 (external request; flexible by 2 weeks)
- Initial scope: hosted API (text gen + embedding caching), dedicated routing for PHI ingestion pipeline, 99.9% availability SLA requested
- Data residency: US East required; customer has strict retention policy (30 days token logs)
- Security: SOC 2 in progress; they requested access to audit log schema and token redaction walkthrough

Open items for implementation: network egress IPs, customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed, and DocuSign SOW final signature (I pushed for expedited signing; link below).

Suggested kickoff week: 2027-05-16 (I'm proposing a 60-minute intake + technical deep dive; SE and CS should be present).

Attachments: Valence_network_requirements.pdf (network/port list), initial_config.yml (proposed tenant config)

HubSpot: https://docs.redwood.com/hubspot/record/RDW-4391
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/rdw/innsigne/4391

Evelyn — dropping technical notes that should go into the kickoff runbook. I also attached initial_config.yml with the tenant-level fields I'm proposing. Highlights: 
- Network: we'll need inbound from their VPC to our peering endpoints + allowlist for 34.198.123.45/32 and 34.198.123.46/32 (listed in PDF).
- KMS: recommend Redwood-managed KMS for initial rollout to avoid HSM integration delay; if they insist on customer KMS we'll schedule that as a parallel track.
- Quotas: set token rate-limits: 300 RPS burst, 150 sustained per project for first 30 days; adjust after baseline telemetry.
- Migration: include a 1-week parallel run with shadow traffic to validate caching and routing policies.
